verdict.rationale: mise is a dev-tool/task-runner whose AI-related capability is exposing its own tasks and environment to AI assistants via an MCP *server* (mise-docs-74), not acting as an MCP *client* that consumes external MCP servers' tools. The story asks about mise consuming/plugging-in other MCP servers, which is a category error for a tool version manager rather than an agent — no evidence shows mise acting as an MCP client.
